rendered:

The text states that "The recovered NMC622 maintained 92.67% of the baseline capacity."

Therefore, if 92.67% of the baseline capacity is 158.0 mAh/g, then the baseline capacity is 158.0 mAh/g / 0.9267 = 170.5 mAh/g.
